per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I searched for a public dataset with paired left and right bovid horn 3D geometry, meaning scans, centerlines or landmark curves. I found none that I could open and verify. The closest items were not usable. The Imperial College MRes dissertation on 3D horn variation in Bovidae is access-restricted. The Harary and Tal horn scans are supplementary material to a paper and have no dataset landing page. The cattle, goat and mouflon asymmetry studies report only horn length and circumference in article tables, with no deposited raw data. The Dryad mule deer record covers antlers, not horns. I fetched no landing page with WebFetch, so I name no dataset rather than risk an unverified identifier. A future test could use MorphoSource bovid skull scans, but I did not identify a specific verified project.

per_claim.no_dataset_reason: Three rounds of searching found no public per-cone parastichy handedness dataset for Norway spruce or any other extant conifer. The searches covered the web, Dryad and Zenodo, and figshare was covered only in the earlier round. The Dryad search page returned HTTP 403. The Zenodo search page showed no results for the query. The web searches found only journal papers that report handedness counts in their text: slash pine, lodgepole pine, black pine, and fossil Araucaria mirabilis cones. The Araucaria cones are fossil and so outside the claim's scope. I could not confirm that any of these papers has a data deposit, and I fetched no dataset landing page, so I name none rather than risk an unverified identifier. The claim could be tested only by new counts or by digitising the tables in the published papers.

Examples are North American trechine beetles, Ozark grotto salamanders, North American cavefishes, and European spiders. A global stygofauna occurrence database appears in a conference abstract, but it has no phylogenetic placement and I did not fetch it. The trechine dataset page was fetched earlier by another attempt, not by me in this session. I name no dataset rather than test a weakened version of the claim.

per_claim.no_dataset_reason: No suitable public per-individual dataset with separate left and right bovid horn measurements could be found and fetched. Searches of Dryad and the wider web returned only datasets that do not record per-side horn values. Examples are Tidière et al. 2020 on ontogenetic horn-length allometry, and a dataset on female horn investment that uses species-level maxima from Bovids of the World. The left-right asymmetry studies I found (Catalan goat horns, mouflon trophies, domestic sheep skull geometric morphometrics) appear as journal articles or institutional repository records. I could not confirm a downloadable raw data deposit for any of them. I opened no dataset landing page, and I name no identifier I did not verify.
